weapons.name: Tea Kettle
weapons.flavor: Standard issue in Desperanza: whistles under pressure and occasionally during combat.

weapons.name: Aspperigo
weapons.flavor: Eddie's favorite and we don't know why.

weapons.name: Vernerider
weapons.flavor: No one can pronounce it right.

weapons.name: Temptrest AR
weapons.flavor: The favorite among Raiders. The most prized possession.

supplies.name: White Bandage
supplies.flavor: A little strip of hope. Mostly adhesive.

supplies.name: Green Bandage
supplies.flavor: Better than white. Still applied with panic.

supplies.name: Blue Bandage
supplies.flavor: Professional-looking enough to inspire misplaced confidence.

supplies.name: Purple Bandage
supplies.flavor: Premium medical tape for premium mistakes.

supplies.name: Panic Paddles
supplies.flavor: Two questionable paddles and one laminated apology. For when 'walk it off' has lost the debate.

supplies.name: Fizz Cell
supplies.flavor: A pocket battery making brave little snapping noises.

supplies.name: Duct-Taped Capacitor
supplies.flavor: Technically a recharge kit. Spiritually a cry for help.

supplies.name: Panic Capacitor
supplies.flavor: Emergency confidence in a handheld brick.

shields.name: Courtesy Bubble
shields.flavor: A polite field that asks incoming fire to please slow down. Most of it reconsiders.

shields.name: Reasonable Bubble
shields.flavor: Mid-range protection for Raiders who have read one safety pamphlet all the way through.

shields.name: Excessive Bubble
shields.flavor: The Gear Weirdos call it mostly theoretical and emotionally proven. The pink is load-bearing.
